decisive_spans.text: Multiple echogenic targets with snowflake appearance in all four heart chambers

response.rationale: The presence of 'Multiple echogenic targets with snowflake appearance in all four heart chambers' and 'Elevated tumor markers' strongly supports Cancer-associated thrombosis. While D1 (Disseminated intravascular coagulation) has support from elevated D-dimer and fibrinogen, the echocardiography findings are highly specific to D2 and less so to D1.
